description.value: Saint Germain Bakery is an award-winning chain founded in 1984 that has trained under pastry chefs from France, Japan, Hong Kong, and Australia, earning multiple Culinary Olympics gold medals. The Kerrisdale location is a standalone street-front shop in a quiet residential neighbourhood, offering cakes, pastries, and baked goods. It is part of a broad BC and Ontario chain, with wholesale supply to major hotels and airlines.
